title: PreviewReview
description: A repo-safe, read-only preview of a proposed artifact, presented to a human reviewer (organizer, steward, facilitator, reviewer) before any documented next step. The schema describes the **shape of the human review boundary** between source material (meeting notes, fixture material, package output, evidence-packet draft) and any subsequent action (publish, apply, export, mutate). It is the missing read-model contract between the no-CLI organizer/member rehearsal workflow (`docs/pilots/no-cli-organizer-member-rehearsal-workflow.md` §3 steps 3 + 6, §7), the evidence export contract (`urn:icn:contract:rehearsal-evidence-export:v1`), and any future shell, wireframe, or accessibility-gated surface. The schema is **read-only**: it does not mutate, publish, export, or apply anything. The `review_status: approved_for_next_step` value records that a human review boundary was crossed; it does **not** mean production deployment, formal pilot authorization, or any actual mutation. Mutation is performed by separate, named, documented endpoints; this contract only describes what a reviewer was shown and what they decided. Partner-internal data does not enter this contract; partner-specific overlays are out-of-scope and live in package-private storage. The schema $id is a non-DNS URN so contract identity does not depend on centralized DNS or registrar infrastructure; see docs/contracts/preview-review.md for the rationale and the architectural principle in docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE_DUE_DILIGENCE.md.
x-icn-must-not-include: real personal names (unless explicitly fictional / example-only)
accommodation or access needs tied to an identifiable person
API tokens, secrets, signed URLs, or session credentials
private Drive / Groups / Sheets paths or content
any field that implies production deployment or formal pilot authorization
free-form mutation payloads (this is a read-model contract; mutation is performed by separate documented endpoints)

schema_version.description: Semver-style version of this schema the preview was authored against. Accepts 'MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH' or 'MAJOR.MINOR'. Bumped only when the schema's required fields or closed enums change.

preview_id.description: Stable, locally-unique identifier for the preview. Producers choose the format; consumers treat it as opaque. Must not encode private data (no emails, phones, sponsor names, or DIDs of unconsented participants).

preview_kind.description: Closed taxonomy describing what kind of preview this is. 'meeting_notes_action_items' = parsed meeting notes proposing action items. 'pending_publish_summary' = staged publish summary before a steward applies/publishes artifacts. 'evidence_packet_preview' = a draft rehearsal evidence packet awaiting privacy / accessibility review before export. 'fixture_demo_preview' = a fixture-only rehearsal preview presented to organizers without any live data path. 'package_artifact_preview' = a package-side artifact preview before evidence export or repo-safe summary creation.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 'date-time' (e.g. 2026-05-05T01:40:13Z). Wall-clock moment the preview was finalized for review.

created_by_role.description: Closed taxonomy of generic role labels for who created the preview. Categories only — never names, emails, or DIDs.

scope.description: What the preview targets, mapped to ICN's constitutional axes. Institution packages bind their local taxonomy to these. Mirrors the action-card scope axis.

source_material.description: Inputs the preview was derived from. Each entry is described by safe basename and category — never by raw external path. 'committed-fixture' = file already in the repository. 'example-snippet' = inline fictional content authored for the preview. 'repo-safe-paste' = content reviewed and confirmed to contain no private fields before being pasted into the preview surface. 'sha256' is optional and only meaningful for committed fixtures or otherwise public content.

basename.description: File or snippet basename only — no directory paths, no Drive URLs, no external links to private content.

sha256.description: Optional content hash; include only when the underlying content is itself repo-safe (committed fixture or fictional example).

summary.description: One-sentence plain-language description of what this material is. Generic enough to publish in a public issue comment.

proposed_artifact.description: The artifact the reviewer is being asked to evaluate. The artifact is a **read-model**: it describes the shape of what would be produced if a separate, documented next step were taken. The schema does not implement that step. Free-form 'detail' is permitted as plain-language text only; structured payloads belong in their own per-kind schemas (this contract is the review-boundary shape, not the per-artifact shape).

kind.description: Closed taxonomy mirroring preview_kind. The artifact kind reflects what would be produced if the next step were taken.

title.description: Short, plain-language title suitable for a list row in an organizer-facing UI.

summary.description: One- or two-sentence plain-language summary of the artifact. The reviewer should be able to understand what they are approving from this summary alone.

detail.description: Optional longer plain-language detail. Free text; no private data. If structured detail is required, it belongs in a per-kind schema, not here.

review_status.description: Closed taxonomy. 'draft' = preview is being assembled, not ready for review. 'ready_for_review' = preview is presented to a reviewer and awaiting a decision. 'changes_requested' = reviewer asked for changes before approval. 'approved_for_next_step' = reviewer approved the preview for the next documented step. **'approved_for_next_step' is not production deployment, not pilot authorization, and not a mutation.** It only records that a human review boundary was crossed; the next step is performed separately by named, documented endpoints. 'rejected' = reviewer declined; the proposed artifact must not proceed.

review_requirements.description: What this preview requires before approval is meaningful. Closed enum of categories the reviewer should have considered. Producers list every requirement that applies; consumers treat the absence of a requirement as 'not asserted by this preview' (not 'not required').

reviewer_actions.description: Optional record of what the reviewer did. Each entry is a closed-taxonomy action plus an optional plain-language note. Roles are generic labels — never names, emails, or DIDs. The recorded_at moment is RFC 3339. This array is not authoritative for governance; it is a review-trail entry that producers may include when the preview surface needs to render a recent-activity timeline.

notes.description: Optional plain-language note. Generic phrasing; no private fields. Consumers must not treat this field as machine-actionable.

privacy_review.description: Privacy review status of this preview. 'reviewer_role' is a generic role label — never a person name. 'status' captures whether the preview was reviewed and whether redactions were applied before display. 'not-reviewed' is permitted but should be uncommon; downstream consumers may treat it as a red flag.

repo_safety.description: Whether the preview is safe to render or store in a public repository. 'repo-safe' is the only classification produced from previews that validate against this schema in normal use. The 'partner-internal-only' value exists as a contractual marker that the producing system itself decided NOT to render through the repo-safe path. The latter MUST NOT appear in any preview checked into the ICN repository. Companion 'notes' is plain language; no private fields.

evidence_links.description: Optional links from this preview to public artifacts that contextualize it — e.g. an evidence packet exported from a prior rehearsal, a public issue, a public ADR. URLs must point to public resources only; never to private partner trackers, Drive paths, or internal links. Each entry includes the related contract URN where applicable so consumers can verify shape independently.

contract_urn.description: Optional non-DNS URN for the related contract (e.g. urn:icn:contract:rehearsal-evidence-export:v1).

url.description: Optional public URL. Omit for in-repo references that have no canonical public URL.

non_claims.description: Required free-text array enumerating the standing non-claims this preview preserves. At minimum: not a mutation, not production deployment, not formal pilot authorization, not private-data handling. Producers may add preview-specific non-claims; producers MUST NOT remove the standing four.
